subject: Visualising a linkage map with haploid data in Rqtl

messages.author: b2ba3ab89c2ba8e9
messages.subject: Visualising a linkage map with haploid data in Rqtl
parts:
Good day

I am trying to visualise a linkage map I constructed in JoinMap, using R/qtl. From the publications I have seen, R/qtl can provide a more compact linkage map. However, I cannot manage to upload the read.cross data for a haploid cross. I tried to upload it as MapQTL data but haploid data is not yet supported in this format. Using MapMaker format I can only submit it as an f2 backcross and then I get an error when it reads the file. Is there another import format I could try to import the haploid linkage map in R/qtl?

Thanks!

messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Visualising a linkage map with haploid data in Rqtl

Perhaps try editing the file to look like a different cross type.

Or if you send them to me, I can try to figure out how to extend r/qtl to handle them.

karl
